Launch-readiness tracking is active: 0 of 4 tasks closed, 4 open. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering field-level rights, data flow/retention, logs/vendors/incident handling, consent/GA4 settings, freshness/correction, and rollback evidence.

Do not close or requeue launch-readiness work without direct evidence. Continue the four existing tasks and attach the consolidated read-only bundle; close only a task whose stated deliverable is evidenced. Next action: produce the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration capture, freshness/correction controls, and rollback evidence.

Fleet compliance and data-quality evidence does not independently block ordinary growth, but it does not support certification or unsupported claims. Technical compliance is 35 pass, 18 fail, and 6 unknown; analytics is yellow with source-permission or collector errors; revenue covers 2026-09-21 only, with $4.92 aggregate commission not assignable to a site.
